participation.context: Entered the two words and stopped the shoes.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Placed the breath before the vowel, and stopped.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Praised the vowel once, and refused twenty bars that would become the dance.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Named the short hem, and hung the kirtle.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

participation.context: Asked for the slippers, was refused, and did not get a book.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Named the forty as a part, and left them unspoken.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: he keeps a mended word and does not drop it

story.body: Garnish entered two words and no speech he could not see. Nick said the mended vowel cleanly. You refused to speak the forty here, and you refused Kemp a book. Phillips kept the cittern until Thursday.

relations.note: he keeps a mended word and does not drop it

title: Took the book back and kept the jig for Thursday

participation.context: Asked if the dance was now, and agreed to wait.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Kept today clear of the jig.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Refused the other bill, and went home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: Today the stage is not yours.

story.body: Kemp asked for the slippers and was told Thursday. You named the other house's bill and did not go. Phillips sent you off a cleared stage.

relations.quote: Today the stage is not yours.
